name: fallback-oracle-deterministic-cache-miss
body: The full-load-fallback oracle models the fact-store cache miss deterministically through the parked-worktree-root plus cache::gc::collect path, not a naturally occurring contention or GC window; upgrade when a hermetic fixture for a natural miss exists. It asserts the freshness verdict (the refusal message) on the fallback database before any mutation, because an admitted mutation re-projects the database and would mask the divergence.
